card.name: Partway through split words, often Spanish
card.fires_on: Word pieces in the middle of a split word, such as Spanish words (Ármate, flores, marítima) and capitalized label terms (IMPTA, CLINICAL, Females). Fires on the piece before the word ends.

modes.label: Spanish word pieces
modes.description: Middle pieces of Spanish words or URL slugs, such as flo before res or mar before itima.

modes.label: Split label terms
modes.description: Pieces inside split drug names or headings in English label text.
